application.name: Requirements Quality Dashboard
application.description: Dashboard for monitoring and analyzing requirements quality metrics based on ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148:2011

completeness.name: Completeness
completeness.description: Measures whether requirements fully express the stakeholder's needs

clarity.name: Clarity
clarity.description: Measures how unambiguous and understandable the requirements are

consistency.name: Consistency
consistency.description: Measures the absence of conflicts between requirements

verifiability.name: Verifiability
verifiability.description: Measures whether requirements can be verified through testing or other means

traceability.name: Traceability
traceability.description: Measures whether requirements can be traced to their source and to other related artifacts

feasibility.name: Feasibility
feasibility.description: Measures whether requirements can be implemented within project constraints

syntax.name: Syntax Compliance
syntax.description: Ensures requirements follow the specified syntax and formatting guidelines

document.name: Document Completeness
document.description: Ensures all required sections of the requirements document are present and filled

quality.name: Quality Score
quality.description: Ensures the overall quality score meets the minimum acceptable threshold

manager.name: Manager Approval
manager.description: Requires explicit approval from a project or requirements manager

phases.name: Requirements Elicitation
phases.description: Initial gathering and discovery of stakeholder needs

phases.name: Requirements Analysis
phases.description: Detailed analysis and refinement of gathered requirements

phases.name: Requirements Specification
phases.description: Formal documentation of requirements in structured format

summary.name: Quality Summary Report
summary.description: Overview of all quality metrics and their current values

trend.name: Quality Trend Report
trend.description: Analysis of quality metrics over time

detail.name: Detailed Quality Report
detail.description: In-depth analysis of each requirement and its quality metrics

compliance.name: Standards Compliance Report
compliance.description: Analysis of compliance with ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148:2011 standards

reviewers.name: Project Manager
reviewers.role: Approves requirements from project management perspective

reviewers.name: Requirements Manager
reviewers.role: Approves requirements from requirements engineering perspective
